notes.title: 1.0 Release and things to come
notes.notes: After our latest update and hot-fix patches, we are ready for your feedback! While we are working on [b]future updates[/b], we would like as much feedback as we can get, so we decided to get this train rolling! Join us on the Steam forums or on our Discord server!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - HASTUR INDUSTRIES IS HERE
notes.notes:
[h1]Important Announcement from Hastur Industries[/h1]

Aspiring workers,

At [b]Hastur Industries[/b], we understand the importance of continuous improvement in the face of evolving challenges. In the spirit of this, we are pleased to announce to you a comprehensive overhaul of the [b]"UNSAFE"[/b] experience.

This update includes:
[list]
[*] Multiple new enemies
[*] New, unforgiving traps
[*] Over a dozen new tools
[*] Procedural map generation
[*] Revamped gameplay
[*] Upgraded Graphics
[/list]
We feel that this is a step in the right direction, but will need your help and feedback to optimize, polish, as well as debug the game. 

[h3]THIS IS A CALL TO ALL AVAILABLE PERSONNEL, GET TO YOUR STATIONS AND START TESTING![/h3]

As a bonus, enjoy a [b]40% discount[/b] for the next week! What are you waiting for?

We will be happy to read your feedback on our discord server here:
[url=https://discord.gg/gaNc3sD4jN]https://discord.gg/gaNc3sD4jN[/url]

Thank you,
    [b]Hastur Industries Management[/b]

PS.

The old version of the game will always be available on Steam under "betas" -> "oldschool".

notes.title: Update news and things to come.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been hard at work on Unsafe and as we get closer to our goal, we wanted to give you an update and a rough outline of things to come. 

This new content we are working on will be released as an update/overhall to the game and will contain multiple new enemies, a lot more tools, procedural map generation and some meta-game. Our goal is to create a solid base of a game, on which we will be able to keep adding content.

We expect to run a beta test in the next couple of months, so that we can get your feedback and make sure the game is as bug free as possible. We then expect to take some time to fix any issues that arise and release the update as soon as those are resolved. From there, our work on Unsafe will be focused on bringing more content in the form of even more enemies, tools and map variations. 

Keep an eye out for the beta announcement!

Thank you!

notes.title: Roadmap update, lots to come!
notes.notes:
Hi @everyone!

Merry Christmas! We hope you are having a good time!
We have some exciting news that we wanted to share with you before the year is over!
As you know, we have been hard at work on Unsafe. All I can say is that there will be significant upgrades to what you've seen so far! 
We have updated our trello roadmap to reflect what we are working on. There you can find hints for multiple enemies, traps, tools and mechanics that are being added to the game! 
We are also working on a much more procedural map generation. All in all, we are aiming to make the game have a lot of content and replayability.

You can find the Trello board here:
https://trello.com/b/OWFznUkd/unsafe-roadmap

Don't forget, winter sales are on and you can find all of our games on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/onskullgames

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Update Notes 17/06
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! With the new update, we are received a lot of feedback and ideas, thank you all! With that in mind, we are working on some finishing touches as well as bug fixing and just pushed a patch. Some of the changes this time are quite significant, especially for solo players, here's a list of some of them:

[list]
[*] Self-revive for Solo players! Holding a revive cell will now give you a second (or third) chance!
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an alert beeping sound to loop infinitely
[*] Other minor balance changes for Solo play
[*] Further powerpad buffs
[*] UI updates and fixes
[*] Other quality of life & bug fixes
[/list]

There's more to come, so keep an eye out! New translations are also being worked on, we'll have news soon! Again, thank you for your feedback and have fun!

OnSkull Games

notes.title: The first major update for Unsafe is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41249876/a5280ae2b99f1a053c81fd1f020d3ec49d324fc7.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

As promised, we are releasing the largest update to "Black Monolith" yet! Unsafe's first map is our testing grounds and has changed a lot over the course of the past months. With this update, it gets a lot closer to the "Unsafe" experience we want to give to players.

Along with the update, we'll have a major discount for this weekend, it starts at June 10th, 12 PM PDT and ends on June 13th! Be sure not to miss it!

What’s new in the Unsafe Update?

[list]
[*] New type of threat added
[*] More Random Events added
[*] New Visuals New In-game UI
[*] New Menu Screen New Tutorial
[*] New Mechanics
[*] New Map flow
[*] New Tools and Upgrades for the biopulse gun
[*] Many Quality of Life and bug fixes.
[*] New Achievements
[/list]

Fixes and improvements will continue to release in the following days, and your feedback will always be more than welcome! 

Thank you and have fun!!!

notes.title: Update testing weekend!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41249876/93e5bb03acad64e5c9df2f5408b1638fa82b91a3.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Great news! We are working hard on finishing a big update for Unsafe's first map, Black Monolith.

This update overhauls the game's UI, upgrades graphics and gameplay and (most importantly) fixes a lot of bugs!

As the update time gets closer, we want to [b]invite all of you to try it out and help us test it![/b]

Any players that want to have an early peek at the new update can do so by following these steps:

[olist]
[*] Find Unsafe on your Steam Library
[*] Right-click -> Properties...
[*] Click on "BETAS"
[*] Enter code "[b]unsafebeta2022[/b]"
[*] Select "testweekend" from the list above
[*] Wait for the game to update and Play!
[/olist]

We will be waiting for your feedback on the Community Forums as well as on our Discord server [url=https://discord.com/invite/FzpcVtnJ2J]here[/url].

We are very excited for this update and hope you are too!

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Update Notes 10/12
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We just pushed an update that includes a lot of Quality of life changes, a bunch of fixes and some work in progress changes. Here's a list of changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to not start when inviting people to the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to not be able to revive.
[*] Visual upgrade of some ground-floor rooms.
[*] Added in-game hints/tips for some mechanics of the game.
[*] Added an intro sequence with some lore
[*] Added visual indication of important objective completion.
[*] Made the lighting a bit more moody and dark, especially in long corridors.
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

Thank you for all the reports and your understanding, especially in our discord server! More fixes will be rolled out frequently!

OnSkull Games

notes.title: Update Notes 29/11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We just pushed an update that includes some fixes and some preparations for new features! Here's a list of changes:

[list]
[*] Observer mode: Downed players can now enter observer mode and see what their friends are doing.
[*] New signal amplifier model and some sounds, preparing for rework.
[*] New enemy proximity sounds for large enemy!
[*] New smaller enemy animation
[*] Fixed an issue that would stop players from running or crouching after getting caught by enemies.
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

Thanks to your help, we have identified an issue that causes the game to not restart and get stuck on the Logo screen, when using the Steam invite interface. This will be fixed very soon.

Thank you for all the reports and your understanding, especially in our discord server! More fixes will be rolled out frequently!

OnSkull Games

notes.title: Update Notes 23/11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a few days and we have been hard at work! We just pushed a big update, fixing a lot of issues and adding some quality of life improvements! Here's a list:

[list]
[*] Updated mission logs to better explain what needs to be done!
[*] The suit's Pulse now charges with mouse 2 and fires with mouse 1. This means that the pulse can be canceled anytime!
[*] The enemy can now change targets, so no following it people!
[*] Improved sound occlusion and sounds in general!
[*] VoiP now has push to talk
[*] Fixed some problems with minigames
[*] Minigame explanations in "help" menu
[*] Fixed an issue where items would stay highlighted when picked up
[*] Fixed an error that sometimes caused players to stay stuck on the enemy
[*] Fixed some item drop points in utility rooms
[*] Fixed an error that caused some sounds to never stop playing
[*] Fixed some objectives on the map, to make what you need to do clearer.
[*] Lot's of other minor fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for all the reports and your understanding, especially in our discord server! More fixes will be rolled out frequently!

OnSkull Games

notes.title: Update notes for 19/11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We just pushed an update, fixing a lot of problems! Here's a list:
[list]
[*] Bigger & Smaller enemy sounds have been updated and fixed to work better!
[*] Fixed a bug that cause voice chat to not work after starting new run.

notes.title: Release is coming!
notes.notes:
We see that everyone is excited to play and we are very happy to hear it! Right now we are doing some final play tests to make sure that multiplayer has as few bugs as possible. Please give us a couple more hours and the game will be out!

Thank you and sorry for the delay!
